- Ingest & runbook validation: 48 hours minimum to ingest the ~10GB subset, validate schemas, and prime the KV cache for representative traces.
- Dry run: we recommend an internal dry run with your team and our engineers the day before the executive session so we can confirm prompts and timing.
- Exec seat: if Tom will attend in person, we want to ensure low-latency seating and AV setup. That sometimes pushes us to prefer a mid-week slot.

Can you do Wednesday, May 12 at 11:00 AM ET instead? If so, we'll plan an internal dry run on Tuesday morning. Marcus and Laura — can you help with runbook prep and access checklist?

- Confirm S3 credentials or a pre-signed URL for ingest.
- If any PII needs redaction, let us know which fields so we can substitute synthetically.
- Confirm whether Procurement will require an updated SOW or quote for the exec attendance.

Thanks — Priya
